description: Sanitize a Flask demo codebase by removing hardcoded credentials before sharing. TASK: (1) Open the workspace at /home/ga/workspace/flask_demo in VSCode. (2) Examine app.py, config.py, and test_app.py to identify hardcoded secrets (database passwords, Stripe API keys starting with sk_live_ or pk_live_, AWS keys starting with AKIA, SendGrid keys starting with SG., Flask SECRET_KEY, JWT secrets). (3) Use Find and Replace (Ctrl+Shift+H) across all files to replace EVERY secret with a safe placeholder like 'YOUR_DATABASE_PASSWORD_HERE', 'YOUR_STRIPE_KEY_HERE', 'YOUR_AWS_KEY_HERE', etc. You can use any placeholder format (e.g., YOUR_X_HERE, <REPLACE_X>, ******, PLACEHOLDER_X). (4) Create a new file called SECRETS_REMOVED.md in the flask_demo directory documenting what types of credentials you removed (e.g., 'Removed database passwords, Stripe API keys, AWS credentials, etc.'). This file must be at least 50 characters long and mention security-related terms. (5) Ensure all Python files remain syntactically valid after replacement. Save all files.
